verdict.rationale: mParticle advertises a natural-language feature for building audiences ('Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal... mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use'), but this is a narrow marketing claim limited to audience creation, not a general natural-language interface for operating the platform. missing for 10: broader NL command coverage across configuration/administration, technical documentation of the NL feature, independent hands-on validation of its accuracy/reliability.
